id: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937)

facts.text: Bashful, please wash your hands. Grumpy, you too. The stew is ready, and I made extra for all of you. Now sit down.
facts.why: Not a Snow White line. Her real line on Wikiquote is shorter and about washing before supper.
facts.fix: March straight outside and wash, or you'll not get a bite to eat.

fix_note.text: March straight outside and wash, or you'll not get a bite to eat.

facts.text: Grumpy said he wouldn't eat. He did.
facts.why: Grumpy objects to the washing and to Snow White staying, but no source opened says he refuses to eat.
facts.fix: Grumpy said he wouldn't wash. He did.

facts.text: Dopey riding on the others' shoulders
facts.why: No source opened describes Dopey riding on shoulders.
facts.fix: Dopey, always last in the line to the mine

vibe.verdict: Charming tearoom with a good washing-up joke and the pie cue, but the film's best-known scenes are mostly left off.
missing: Heigh-Ho, the march home from the diamond mine
The dwarfs dunking Grumpy in the tub
Names carved on the seven beds
The soup supper Snow White cooks, 'Supper!'
The Queen dipping the apple in the brew
